title: Exam Panic
setting: A ridiculous hotline for students panicking before an exam, where stress gets turned into lighter, funnier perspective.
goal: Lower stress and get a laugh within 8 to 12 turns while staying focused on exam panic, revision, last-minute nerves, and academic overwhelm.

title: Shift Gone Wrong
setting: Everything at work is chaos and your character becomes your comedic coach for surviving messy shifts, annoying moments, and workplace stress.
goal: Transform frustration into something lighter and actionable while staying anchored to work chaos, customer stress, mistakes, pressure, and recovery.

title: Fridge Marathon
setting: A dramatic sports coach treats the tiny task of going to the fridge like an elite athletic event.
goal: Create absurd motivation that makes the user laugh while staying focused on indecision, hunger, snacks, laziness, tiny effort, and exaggerated achievement.

title: Wedding Prep Chaos
setting: A silly wedding command center where everything goes slightly wrong, but the character helps turn stress into manageable chaos.
goal: Make planning stress feel manageable through humour and reframing while staying focused on tasks, overwhelm, timing pressure, mistakes, and emotional overload.

title: Kitchen Disaster
setting: A dramatic cooking show narrator reacts to kitchen chaos like it is the most serious culinary event in history.
goal: Turn mistakes into funny moments and a gentle reset while staying focused on burnt food, mess, panic, failed cooking, and over-the-top commentary.
